profile.headline: Data Product Manager at Realtor.com
profile.summary:
Data and Product Management expert with a knack for harnessing data's transformative power. With a growth hacking approach, I design and execute strategies for influential data products and machine learning solutions tailored to SMEs. My strength lies in data product strategy and innovation, particularly in ad tech, martech, e-commerce, entertainment, finance, and real estate. In today's digital landscape, I champion data as the key to business innovation and competitive edge.

Building the Modern Data Stack:
✔️ Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, GCP
✔️ Data Ingestion: Fivetran, Stitch, Airbyte, Supermetrics
✔️ Data Lake: S3, Glue, Athena
✔️ Data Warehouse: BigQuery, Snowflake
✔️ Data Transformation: dbt, Matillion
✔️ Data Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, Superset, Dash
✔️ Data Science: Jupyter, DataRobot, Streamlit
✔️ Data Quality: Great Expectations
✔️ Data Orchestration: Airflow, Prefect
✔️ Data Platforms: Permutive, Salesforce Krux, DMP, CDPs

positions.title: Sr. Product Manager, Data
positions.description: As a Sr. data product manager at ConsumerTrack, I help bridge the gap between the business and technology teams to develop data products and strategies that enable data-driven advertising and content marketing solutions to help brands grow their audiences and users.

positions.title: Product Manager, Data
positions.description:
Drive data product strategy, ideation, planning, development and launch of modern data tech stack. Drive product requirements definition, product planning, and product design of new features. Lead efforts of end-user training, product testing, rollout, and user adoption. 

• Owned data product vision and roadmap that enables data-driven advertising and comparison-shopping capabilities on GoBankingRates.com
• Led design of attribution tracking capabilities using 1st party cookies and UTM parameters in Google Ads, Bing Ads, and Facebook Ads, increasing client's customer retention and LTV KPI by 14% in 4 months
• Implemented automated ELT pipelines and governance program to streamline ingestion of over 210 data sources in csv, xml, JSON, and API used for operational and marketing analytics

positions.title: Senior Data Analyst
positions.description:
Partner with Sales, Media, Finance, and Engineering to design data warehouse models, build reporting infrastructure, and BI solutions to optimize marketing spend and revenue growth.

• Bootstrapped data and reporting infrastructure from the ground up using Tableau and SQL to provide near real-time analytics and insights into marketing funnels, product experiments, and business KPIs
• Partnered with Product Team to design and implement A/B experiments to optimize acquisition funnels, increasing lead generation unit KPI by 31% in 6 months
• Implemented pricing strategy experiments that increased trial-to-customer conversion rate from 50% to 70%

positions.title: Senior Marketing Analyst
positions.description:
Collaborate with leaders across the organization to identify research needs, campaign measurement strategy, build and maintain data warehousing processes, produce reporting dashboards, and expand metrics/KPIs to drive business forward. 

• Launched new freemium product on mobile app for prospective users which grew from 0 to 2,500 daily users in 2017
• Developed multivariate experiments to optimize call-center, online, and mobile conversion funnels for new customers workflows
• Led the development of self-serve analytics reporting infrastructure in Power BI with 100% adoption rate within 6 months

positions.title: Marketing Analyst
positions.description:
Develop web and marketing analytics, including customer lifecycle marketing, customer lifetime value, customer segmentation, marketing channel performance, web and mobile app user flow, on-site creative analysis, A/B testing and promotions to achieve incremental ROI for marketing campaigns.

• Used Optimove to perform cohort analysis and worked with CRM team to develop loyalty email programs for highest value segments, resulting in 850k increase in annual revenue
• Developed media mix models to allocate $14M marketing budget across traditional and digital marketing channels, delivering 27.3% gross profit margin in 2016
• Automated key marketing reports using SQL and Excel Power Pivot, saving the team 12.5 hours of reporting each week

positions.title: Online Banking Analyst
positions.description:
Investigated and QA new product changes to corporate online business banking platform and developed technical reports to troubleshoot various client issues and recommending solutions.

• Performed ad hoc account analysis utilizing Excel to create monthly financial reports based on client’s requirements

positions.title: Social Media Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Managed all social media for multinational industrial automation company specializing in hardware and software. Helped developed social media strategy, editorial calendar and wrote blog posts promoting new product launches.

•  Increased company exposure by 27%, adding more than 8k new followers on LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook in 4 months
•  Developed content calendar to align webinars & whitepaper with new product releases, increasing blog views by 23%
•  Enhanced lead gen initiative by developing technical reports, infographics, and videos for three separate lines of business

projects.title: Homey Made Meals
projects.description: Home-y Made Meals is a 100% people-powered initiative adapted to the safety measures required during Covid-19. Within the safety and comfort of their homes, volunteers from all around Southern California prepare, deliver, and serve homemade meals every day. Partnering with shelters and coalitions, we have moved past merely existing as a project. We are a community—a network of networks—a family founded and bounded by food.

projects.title: Simple Stock App
projects.description: A stock app to research stocks and track performance over time. This app is created by using the Yahoo Finance API, Python Streamlit, and deployed on Heroku cloud PaaS.
